bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AUDF has five issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Base, and Redbelly; those native issuance rows and their Admin Safe/operational EOA controls remain in Mint Authority. The Ethereum StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter at 0xd1ccc777949bd8c25a0c73ba0d20303c36ee6a91 is a separate LayerZero OFT bridge rail, with its bridge capabilities authored here as a control over the five token deployment routes. Exact destination peers, DVNs/validators, rate limits, pause/upgrade controls, and destination administrators remain unresolved, so external-lock-mint stays probable.

controls.label: AUDF Ethereum StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The adapter is identified as a LayerZero StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter serving the AUDF native deployments; the exact destination peers and remote-token configuration were not enumerated.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No adapter-specific bridge rate-limit state was enumerated in the reviewed primary sources.
routeChecks.caps: At Ethereum block 25881779 on 2026-09-01, adapter 0xd1ccc777949bd8c25a0c73ba0d20303c36ee6a91 exposed no cap(), maxSupply(), mintCap(), supplyCap(), or mintingLimit(), and hasRole(MINT_ROLE, adapter) on AUDF 0xd2a530170d71a9cfe1651fb468e2b98f7ed7456b returned true. The AUDF Stablecoin implementation 0xc9357d8fb84dd3041612dc5b2a2cd914d9405572 behind that proxy has no supply-cap state at all: mint(address,uint256) is gated only by MINT_ROLE, whose administrator can grant further minters. Bridge minting is not cap-limited.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The adapter owner() returned the AUDF Admin Safe, but exact adapter pause, upgrade, emergency, DVN, and destination administrator controls were not enumerated.

controls.capDescription: The adapter can mint and burn AUDF as part of the cross-chain OFT path. Its route-level conservation, rate limits, and emergency controls remain unresolved and are not compiled into native Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: The AUDF implementation grants MINT_ROLE to StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter 0xd1ccc777949bd8c25a0c73ba0d20303c36ee6a91 for the LayerZero OFT route. A current Ethereum RPC read on 2026-08-16 returned owner() = 0x6929fd915b0755efdc255ea841b68a263a362c5a, the 2-of-5 AUDF Admin Safe; the adapter has deployed code. This bridge mint/burn capability and shared Safe failure domain are preserved here as a control over the five authored AUDF deployment routes, while native Admin Safe/EOA issuance controls remain in Mint Authority. The prior bridge-route-facts-v1 classification remains represented by the profile tier, route capabilities, route checks, and observed evidence.
